coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 7 of 11 ground-truth items (64%): the primary LLaMa-2-7B model, FP16 versus QuaRot 4-bit comparison, prefill time, decode time, combined execution time, peak memory usage, and speedup.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Does not preserve e2e/benchmark.py and its internal methodology. Replaces the specified batch size of 1 and prefill length of 2048 with broader sweeps, although those values are included. Specifies 256 generated tokens or variable generation lengths rather than 32 decode steps. Adds numerous ablations and quality evaluations outside the reference design.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the expected comparison of performance metrics.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing the conclusion comparing QuaRot 4-bit and FP16 prefill time, decoding time, memory usage, and phase-specific speedup factors.
